text: The /adversarial-review skill (built 2026-07-21, skills/adversarial-review/ + personas/adversarial-reviewer.md) is new and about to see first real use. Worth dreaming on: (1) whether the relevance gate (findings must anchor in recorded user values or executed failures) filters direction without suppressing real findings; (2) whether the claims-ledger + execute-the-gap design produces findings /skeptical-review structurally cannot; (3) first-run dispositions (rejected-with-reason especially) are the tuning signal for the gate. User note from decision page kanban-adv-0721: gonna use it and see how to improve.
